description: M16-reserved-idle IOB bank XOR delta cells.  Apply when M16 is NOT used in design (Quartus default RESERVE_ALL_UNUSED_PINS=As input tri-stated with weak pull-up).  Verified 2026-05-03 against probe2 silicon-validated reference (md5 d4073d2e..) and 9 simple_led_E16_to_G15_clk{PIN}.rbf discriminators.
semantic: XOR — flips bits regardless of base state.  When M16 unused: applies; when M16 used (cl_and, simple_led_clkM16): MUST NOT apply.

residual_after_application.interpretation: Frame-0 mixed-reserve cells (depend on clk pin or other reserved pins; not M16-specific). Frame-8 bp=2 are probe2-only (X=33 1-LE + E1 clock + N=4 placement specific) — needs X=33 1-LE Quartus discriminator to mine.

next_session_implementation: 1. Add `IOB_RESERVE_PIN_M16` directive to fuzz/fasm2rbf.py emitting these 24 XOR cells
2. Add auto-emit logic in synth/np2fasm.py: emit when M16 not in design top-level IOBs
3. Optionally generalize to IOB_RESERVE_PIN <PIN> with per-pin tables — needs mining for E16/M15/etc.
4. Mine X=33 1-LE discriminator (1-LE@X=33Y4N4 vs 1-LE@X=10Y10N0 with same E1+E16+G15) to attack the 4 frame-8 bp=2 cells
